eligible_population: P1 status=OK and posture in empty/supine/prone/left/right
excluded_population: P1 WARN others.json records without fixed posture and variation labels
warn_rule: per-posture robust z-score > 4.5 on any metric
reject_rule: source is unreadable or structurally invalid during P2 re-read
important_boundary: WARN is a visual-review candidate, not a confirmed sensor or label defect.
